description: Where does my x402 API rank in Bazaar search? Rank check runs the search a buyer agent would run for your task and returns your rank, the listings ahead of you, the signals where you trail them (payers, calls, description, example, schema, price), what the three winners' descriptions say that yours doesn't, and your share of voice across the buyer searches of your category. Search rank and competitor analysis for x402 listings. A three-result sample is free at /v1/seller/rank/sample. Price: $0.01 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.01 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.
